name: 41258-ngramdecode-qwen306b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one eighth of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one in-process vLLM engine on one node. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector, no offloading.
architecture: dense causal decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), bf16, public and ungated: 28 layers, hidden 1024, 16 query and 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, intermediate 3072, vocab 151936, ~0.60e9 parameters, ~1.2 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 41258.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text` from guidellm's faker-backed generator, single turn, text only, 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 tokens out per request (min == max on both ends). Sampling is declared in `scenario.json`: temperature 0.8, no top-k, no top-p, no penalties. Prompts are tokenized with add_special_tokens=True, so the reported prompt length runs a token or two over 1024.
purpose: A compact text assistant drafting long-form replies from page-length prompts for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The model and topology this setup serves, in the form `vllm serve --config` takes.
# `speculative-config` MUST stay a single-line flow mapping: the declaration is read line by line
# and indented lines are skipped, so a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts without
# it at rc=0. It is a mapping and not a JSON string because the value goes straight to
# AsyncEngineArgs, whose `speculative_config` is typed `dict | None`.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
speculative-config: {"method": "ngram", "num_speculative_tokens": 16, "prompt_lookup_min": 2, "prompt_lookup_max": 4}

# `vllm` and not the default `auto`: this checkpoint ships a generation_config.json carrying
# temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, and the declared requests use none of them.
generation-config: vllm
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 128
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
